channel.title: The Local France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Local France (thelocal.fr)

item.title: Avalanche risk: Is it no longer safe to ski off piste in the French Alps?
item.description: The number of deaths caused by avalanches in the French Alps continues to rise with four more skiers killed in early February. So is it still safe to ski off-piste in France?

item.title: 17 key questions to ask before buying your 'dream home' in rural France
item.description: Property prices in French cities can be astronomical (looking at you, Paris), so prices in the countryside can seem very tempting. Samantha David spells out the many essential questions you need to ask before taking the plunge.

item.title: Macron warns US trade 'threats' and 'intimidation' are not over
item.description: French President Emmanuel Macron has called on Europe to boost investment in strategic sectors or risk being "swept aside" in the face of competition from the United States and China, in an interview published Tuesday.

item.title: French expression of the day: démarrer sur les chapeaux de roues
item.description: This French expression doesn't have anything to do with hats on wheels...

item.title: Flood warnings in western France: Three départements put on orange alert
item.description: French weather forecaster Météo France placed three départements in western France on orange alert on Tuesday over the risk of floods with rivers in the area in danger of bursting their banks.

item.title: French man charged with rape, sexual assault of 89 minors
item.description: French prosecutors Tuesday announced that a 79-year-old former educator had been charged in 2024 for aggravated rape and sexual assault committed against 89 minors in multiple countries between 1967 and 2022.

item.title: Trump tariffs hurt French wine and spirits exports
item.description: US tariffs hit French wine and spirits shipments hard last year, playing a major role in the overall drop of eight percent in value of one of France's top exports, a trade body said Tuesday.

item.title: Could it become easier to get cash at an ATM in rural France?
item.description: Getting cash out in rural France has become more complicated in recent years as ATMs become more scarce, but senators are making a new push to make access to cash a legal right.

item.title: OPINION: Warning, the new French civics test for citizenship is harder than I imagined
item.description: Anyone wanting to become a French citizen, now has to take a 40-question civics test and it’s not that easy, writes The Local’s Ben McPartland.

item.title: In Pictures: Pool on wheels brings swim lessons to rural France
item.description: Armed with swimsuits, caps and goggles, rural French children are gaining access to swimming lessons close to home at an unlikely venue: a retrofitted trailer truck.
